 Timothy Rapp Oct 18, 2026 Jim Nantz attempted a peanut punch on JJ Watt as the former NFL defensive lineman demonstrated how running backs are trying to protect the football this season during the broadcast of the Buffalo Bills vs. Las Vegas Raiders.
 It... was a mistake.

 Watt was best known for rushing the quarterback during his career, but don't forget that he also had three offensive touchdowns as a red-zone receiving threat. The man has good hands (to go alongside his brute strength).
